「本仙云游四海，指点过的人不在少数。其中，当数申鹤这孩子与本仙最为相似。若不是她身为凡人，本仙倒想将她一直留在身旁。」——留云借风真君

申鹤本是驱魔世家旁系之子，出于一些原因被留云借风真君收养。

对申鹤来说，留云借风真君是一位博学健谈的师父。

对留云借风真君来说，申鹤也是她指点过的人类中最特别的那个。

以人类之身与仙家一同生活并非易事，但申鹤体质特殊、意志过人，又极有仙术天赋，很受众仙家认可。不过，长年累月修行加上吃仙草、饮山露的生活习惯，让她离人间的生活越发遥远，甚至被当成过神秘的白发仙人。

性格中偶然流露出的锋芒与身上绑缚的红绳，也为她的「神秘」再添一笔。若把她的过去写成故事，想必会有多个版本。

天上仙女也好，白发魔头也罢，人们将如何看待这个神秘的女子？而掩藏在她身上的秘密与真心，也如山间云雾一般难以捕捉。

申鹤本是驱邪世家旁系之子，却在种种机缘巧合之下，意外成为了仙家弟子。名义上师从留云借风真君，但凭借绝佳的根骨与悟性，很快赢得了其他几位仙人喜爱。

日后陆续从其他仙人处学习，终于以人类之身修出了一身仙家术法。

气质出尘，举手投足间像是能看见仙气缭绕。一眼看去，说是世外真仙也毫不为过。

不过，正因她长年隐修在山林之间，身边除去几位仙人，来去的便只有些仙禽灵兽。

长此以往，她的个性越发淡漠疏远。

{"list":[{"tab_name":"汉语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我名申鹤，命格孤煞，易伤身边人，仙人叮嘱要以此红绳锁魂，控制杀心。若你不畏惧与我同行…很好，就请伸出手来吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9ed51481f9ee8c84ae7bfcbeab629245_1428618846276890292.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·归宿","content":"人间的归宿是一种奢望，我早已习惯跟山川与鸟兽作伴了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c1c7aa31ce9e80924893850cff9dc594_1098508899965567341.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·要诀","content":"回向正道，保身护命…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a608f638ef9bb2a712e573dad06926fd_3712491263402109871.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·刀枪无眼","content":"刀枪无眼，红绳的力量也有极限，所以我才不喜欢人多的地方。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b3a6094bbf827b482197ca08b21461a5_4217300604021167154.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"按照凡人的做法，这种时候，是否应该…撑伞？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5e079754e4798085d736685b5a624965_2219328038420089413.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"雨过天晴…","content":"天气变好，我也很开心。只希望没有人来打扰…如果有，就让他们消失好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/87df615d41ee9ee0488ee650adc63f35_5580314364980565720.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"把魔物冻在原地，雷劈下来就能瞬间解决它们，还不会让衣服沾上尘土。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c0bbc46e28127d8d0a26e857bb0189ad_6285733008512228387.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"嗯…师父最喜欢庆云顶上的罡风。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/51f53b8ea876ebe1bfbb8e128487749e_8460709727721588000.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早安。晨露很甜，要分一点给你吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0867541d28665ecc45906f54355db507_2614219336822731622.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"若是午后困乏，不妨试试打坐养神，很有效果。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5f085dd6392252bc4e122b074e9cf361_8960052995474553512.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"不知道你是喜欢人间的灯火，还是山林的月光？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d5984295799e20c5bdeca8472c38e37f_6817106575197215211.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"放心休息吧，我睡眠很浅，有什么动静，我会替你查看的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c32069a8f5c07979a0a15f0dd11b55fb_2447756724975139650.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤自己·本能","content":"磨砺自身，修炼方术，都是本能使然，想要保全自己而已。我没有兼济苍生的胸怀，惩奸除恶只是顺手，不必感谢我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/058e7e40d3268a8f4c39138b5b6cb4c3_2559962517954296062.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤自己·异类","content":"受我恩惠的人叫我仙人，被我惩罚的人喊我魔女，呵…不管是仙是魔，终究都是跟凡人不同的异类罢了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0ddf376ffcf9ffad4f3f01e412ce4d1b_573682301437966816.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·待人接物","content":"我很少下山，不懂得多少待人接物的道理。发生冲突的时候，我一律按自己的方式处理。但，如果你觉得不妥，都请告诉我，即使不理解，我也会听你的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/42d29fd7509dc0f900cf1e1e60ffa76d_7493632310335383058.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·红绳","content":"师父赐我红绳用以压制心性，但这些日子你我同修，我才真正领悟到要诀，力量收放也更自在…你才是真正能锁住我的红绳。若你懂得这份心情，就请留在我身旁。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f76b0d78575a71d7d7a5010ae15a65e1_3871654314041589736.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"原来这颗闪耀的石头叫做「神之眼」？呵…有缘既得，无缘便失。日后倘若缘分消散，它也会熄灭吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/efd9e8708929121a171d868575b9ef37_378807769827430097.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"邪祟易驱，心魔难除。若自身无法放下执念，仙法与术式都无从挽回。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/103bc8d6f17aa8903f5f0b924473d7da_2828815369493710769.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"为什么说「初雪多浪漫」？那处山巅日日下雪，何日才算是初雪？我不理解，请你告诉我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f3dc2cd2c62d9c82e9cd1a09649f8704_1492779479640270869.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"人们所谓的财富，对我而言没什么用。但到了凝光小姐手里，却能解决连刀枪都无法处理的难题。她能掌握人间规则，洞察人心…师父说，这些连仙人都无法做到。我很佩服她。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b003768c0adf2f652c6cf9c95f085eb9_7887724378197199114.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗…","content":"与她相处不用讲究礼节，交谈时也不用揣测深意，让我轻松了不少。只是…她身边总是有人，听说船上还有诸多船员…我需要跟你一起，才能应对人多的场合。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/41ebbcbe5a81095acd1b7450f3b6e025_5773404464000780140.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇…","content":"云堇唱的…叫做「璃月戏」吧？我很喜欢这种形式。不必亲见其面，就能了解他人的事迹。如果将来她把你唱进戏里，那一定会是非常精彩的故事，我很期待。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d65e901823c25ec13173d533ebadb6f3_8783799155809803659.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于甘雨…","content":"我从师父那里听过许多有关她的事…她原先在我心中的形象，和实际差距还是挺大的。放心，我不会说出去。说起来，璃月港的工作竟这般繁忙…看来融入人间，也要付出一些代价。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d66d3ff9f27048856c2d518a4c1a85f6_534203789106849320.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云…","content":"真没想到我在这世上…还有「亲缘」。他若是有什么修行上的困惑，我愿帮忙解答。不过，得请他上山来。他们一家太过热情，我不知道该如何回绝才符合礼数…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/627306e6bd592470fd7ea7f637a97f92_8058692403419711098.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"我曾见到他凑在你耳旁不知说些什么。若他敢威胁你，我一定会将他…嗯？只是朋友间的玩闹话？当真如此吗…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d72e7dc41613601238e74184f1d7ebd1_8659761457203392217.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"那位先生自称是凡人，却与身为仙人的师父很熟络。师父曾说，如果碰见他在仙府前的石凳上饮酒，莫要打扰，让他静静独坐一会。我照做了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/309c6916ec4af5a9ee4d8e8d8498773b_2477128527870453953.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于白术…","content":"他的药草品质很好，为人也随和周到。相比起来，脖子上的小蛇倒是口无遮拦…放心，我没有动手。我还不至于和一条蛇置气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ff93b438f724b126bf287c35cbd60615_8207255670357410333.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"她在附近山林游荡时，经常会唱奇怪的歌。久而久之，我把她的歌断断续续听了个遍。听习惯了也还是觉得奇怪，但，我并不讨厌。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e17e6f6b6e3ebc9bdcbf2cc1e8027a07_6046526646903266154.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"印象中他一直不苟言笑。近来见他，虽说沉默依旧，但…像是比从前轻松了不少。兴许是结识了哪位良人吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d4b815011ce6cc5f4277f76c9425a98b_6636264668514250000.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于闲云","content":"上回，师父带漱玉来万民堂吃饭，漱玉言谈间已有了几分师父的神形…我也是在师父的呵护下如此成长，不知道我的举止，是否也带着些师父的样子呢…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/22/271743012/466f6a208379da6d8877097c39113a37_7419982799964891713.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"p1shdrs4focrn0mwpkz4iipwgnvpal7.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其一","content":"请不必在意人们对我的称呼，我不是仙人，也没什么神通。生于驱魔世家的旁系，长在远离璃月港的山间，只能算是个仙家弟子，仅此而已。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/021ddfe4fdd91dfa4a6303709e1db7da_2573699135732032613.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其二","content":"遇到恶意滋事的人，人们似乎都会选择上前说教，我不太明白。明明可以直接将这些拦路碍事、心存歹念的恶人斩草除根，为什么要这般麻烦？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fcfdc36aa9fedccf70a0368b8889e209_3825261489620502656.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其三","content":"我师从多位仙家，静心修炼。随着修为提升，他们不再传授我新的术式，而是改教我怎样收敛杀性。别紧张…像平地凿出深坑，树木连根拔起之类的事，只在远离人烟的山林中发生过，从未波及过无辜性命。况且，现在我也已经能控制自我了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/447192ae854c99ba800d4d61059f07c1_4863030696766752969.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其四","content":"父亲想用我的血肉换回母亲的生命。自从被他丢在山洞，我一度期盼过他会回来救我。一天、两天、三天…我拼尽全力与魔物厮杀，直到倒下都没能等到他。我不知道，究竟是我命格孤煞才遭人遗弃，还是命途坎坷使得我萌生出这股煞气？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/810aebc2f8f1f61b19ffad6f267d47c2_939309441058842252.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其五","content":"有一回，我瞒着师父偷偷下山回到村里，却发现原本的村庄荒弃了，父亲早已去世。我突然明白，自己与血亲的缘分彻底断绝了。在乎的往事永无后话。自那日起，我一度舍弃人间种种…直到遇见你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cd92d65c6ea7b8a3a9a476f94e6d4071_9130580045681627564.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"申鹤的爱好…","content":"打坐的要点在于「静」，需要摒弃杂念，用身体感受周遭气息，它能让我迅速回归自我。听师父说，修为达到足够境界后，打坐的姿势就不用再拘泥，仙人哪怕站立着都能打坐…我还远远不够。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bf3d3b550086e08fc6bdd9d294394a9e_4253131290264163054.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"申鹤的烦恼…","content":"害怕失去重要之人、想要拯救重要之人…这种心情会将整颗心紧紧揪住，以前从未体会过。这是困扰，但…也是寄托。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/707c509dd544a8ac72742c7cd6e7c230_4986830705694345803.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"下山期间尝了不少菜，但都不太记得味道了。唯独从前在家吃的那碗面，永远忘不了…不该记住才对，不该记住才对…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4963a87da4eade8bdcf0b21e50594a8c_465836370628694622.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"药草嚼得久了，只剩苦味与涩味…修行多年，我早已习惯这些清规戒律了。仙人们？「仙人不会被人间俗物阻碍修为，所以可以敞开吃各式菜肴。」…这是师父的原话。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8f157202f4b5ee5ea6c281a982f2b2d8_2048651601755470932.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"这般滋味…真的是我能够享受的吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/cec4040a28d83b633f92de86e8ba1c42_5797841548152290283.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"你做的饭菜，确实美味。无法割舍。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/5f9ac8ef30ba4a8f094d92fac75677d5_5696812751549875659.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"也好。这样的味道，我早就熟悉了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/aa62204a113a1132001b70fa1c71d203_8129063063366019961.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"我听说生辰是个值得铭记的日子，人们会向寿星送上礼品以示庆贺。身外之物，我不太了解。银河夜色，是我在山林中见过最美丽的事物。我将湖面冻成明镜，让浮云和星斗映照在眼前，跟你共贺生辰…希望你喜欢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/66161f5e4533078c857cf2c8dd517b51_9101332669778494814.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"我能操控的力量…愈发强大了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0c3ad2f55f02d0665ffecf0759b06adc_3005010938850676790.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"师父若知道了，怕是会让我多系几根红绳吧…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/35107f99b60a7f74f3b551f9b3d09f8f_4287637269286199535.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"这段日子，我闭关修炼的时长有所削减，修为却不知不觉地增进…嗯，也许只有跟你一起才能做到。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/329792659c3623682b42b0a3301e2896_3538917607148193337.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"「心无杂念，方可超然」，这是我从前所想。经历种种才明白，唯有心存牵挂，才能唤醒守护的欲望，让力量…变得有意义。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/913554210f8e0254b04125f5b31112c2_593267354734757616.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"听令！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b699195eff6610f0658bd3e359faef64_5340588555671439983.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"显！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/439f4262c15de9aa7172750b6389d509_889242264404489966.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"魂出！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b829dc02e96e6e25dab5540c0780784b_3187428900191377519.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"炼气化神！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a90bfa495934447882a69a15baa89596_1893635399942062467.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"意生冰身！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4aa3894f317b93f4f917c891071ee44e_3475932538457490334.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其六","content":"付君真形！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b3085668d192fc85d138c7d243cb94d3_5895419461384572534.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"天真敕奏！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/270d5a707f42816764690b2cdc60c4be_2613688059553901840.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"寒冰变神！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b5c52c4059089bf4e2f8b814e2a09277_4500473582916845437.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"依律奉行！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/95aff3e8b0804523491cb0c34fc6d3b8_1063083320752861925.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"这就是凡间的宝物吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e7d536cbde69eb65956f32255d6f4789_2417809011369801608.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"与仙人法宝有何区别？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/be6f56eededcfa23a79097d80bce4ddc_7843853248667460605.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"这些东西…该用到何处？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fb827eed627a3ddfebbb0d1f37478cc9_3489976371678705994.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"休要怪我…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/14301ee8605da4e6254350b004bbbaa8_4142191979749020180.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"我不甘心…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ced5680136a47180ca290c4706de9207_6717960888058320107.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"必须…诛除！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/67ffcfbdc4a4e27c50d19523de37cac7_908129226435934382.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"不必勉强。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/28c4b1ac966a34ba62aa618c5122be12_4850522668304667440.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"我来了结。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/91b772867947cc288220fc1797b61988_4670074805648132151.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"难逃…宿命…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e4339fb532f99ec1577179af8c0d3c0f_9106118678962518373.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"死丧既定…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3ad4a75391671406e9197d9d81e2677e_4096968387946920508.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"劫煞为灾…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e1670cc4e2e129e09e0f5cd5b0d5c478_102148012618642307.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"不成气候。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2d965e9ad8edcd368cbbf84d6cc5c5b1_7179646601661275383.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"休想！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6a3c920dcd4412a98a7d33ba15ea777d_2430636962430957974.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"别后悔！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4b0dd27505f3a22ca087aa6afbaebe0f_5986937904311949285.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"团队作战…是什么意思？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/59777db6c40cc61b2585955444af96dc_6862094808398419084.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"明白，站在这里就行了是吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bc7459d1d7a855878bbbb9a0c0f0c3e4_6890329284222546859.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"…听君敕令。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d22cf9e49a9c8814cc8db908f116996f_7675080528722428525.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1703116297999_0"},{"tab_name":"日语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我名申鹤，命格孤煞，易伤身边人，仙人叮嘱要以此红绳锁魂，控制杀心。若你不畏惧与我同行…很好，就请伸出手来吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6987e7239ca18b31067bd50293139300_4611671035526259313.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·归宿","content":"人间的归宿是一种奢望，我早已习惯跟山川与鸟兽作伴了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5ff8ebb02de9df76f95bc55cf84c5633_4523931700977796232.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·要诀","content":"回向正道，保身护命…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fb84861cf3de3f5824526fa0432da25e_7039528629287713339.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·刀枪无眼","content":"刀枪无眼，红绳的力量也有极限，所以我才不喜欢人多的地方。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bf0e549d0275ac65438abc58137e509e_7466106250938682344.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"按照凡人的做法，这种时候，是否应该…撑伞？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/317cbf067e93d8e82b2c9be5fc60127d_5450927607118566232.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"雨过天晴…","content":"天气变好，我也很开心。只希望没有人来打扰…如果有，就让他们消失好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8b38f4dba238a4281acd8257e565eff8_8874853940092163775.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"把魔物冻在原地，雷劈下来就能瞬间解决它们，还不会让衣服沾上尘土。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9a1e53bcc8950b9acecdeed9de9ee0bc_543086825615799133.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"嗯…师父最喜欢庆云顶上的罡风。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/764fcae290e298670cd9ec00a3bb8958_8545895261707552596.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早安。晨露很甜，要分一点给你吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5291f4dc4d1939cc064989da320242be_7138957762277458131.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"若是午后困乏，不妨试试打坐养神，很有效果。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9a2fe28633b6342b1145bc3e1c92e627_7865151765919658891.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"不知道你是喜欢人间的灯火，还是山林的月光？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/db273ed08666db76ecb649d7d7319561_715965334785268084.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"放心休息吧，我睡眠很浅，有什么动静，我会替你查看的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/76768c799389cf94c0f1c75b19a691b7_4325656573219390325.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤自己·本能","content":"磨砺自身，修炼方术，都是本能使然，想要保全自己而已。我没有兼济苍生的胸怀，惩奸除恶只是顺手，不必感谢我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/46d3ed094e44444c1906cac1b6a7ef87_4775054765053825290.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤自己·异类","content":"受我恩惠的人叫我仙人，被我惩罚的人喊我魔女，呵…不管是仙是魔，终究都是跟凡人不同的异类罢了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/aab9d7256523a613cfe803968063b0a7_2223765633377918862.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·待人接物","content":"我很少下山，不懂得多少待人接物的道理。发生冲突的时候，我一律按自己的方式处理。但，如果你觉得不妥，都请告诉我，即使不理解，我也会听你的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f1181ee1b1f07f319250d2605545fda4_8141224473695403585.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·红绳","content":"师父赐我红绳用以压制心性，但这些日子你我同修，我才真正领悟到要诀，力量收放也更自在…你才是真正能锁住我的红绳。若你懂得这份心情，就请留在我身旁。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1664e5097a7a453338236e39c21a1c88_1624986631727268167.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"原来这颗闪耀的石头叫做「神之眼」？呵…有缘既得，无缘便失。日后倘若缘分消散，它也会熄灭吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/de0a746cfe151e5c30bc43c5a18f5679_5949911692438385880.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"邪祟易驱，心魔难除。若自身无法放下执念，仙法与术式都无从挽回。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f74e27c124e43b29390bee768a10b3fe_1034327549332333584.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"为什么说「初雪多浪漫」？那处山巅日日下雪，何日才算是初雪？我不理解，请你告诉我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2353c4a87c749dbd17b6dd4cf5846317_6535575663913711279.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"人们所谓的财富，对我而言没什么用。但到了凝光小姐手里，却能解决连刀枪都无法处理的难题。她能掌握人间规则，洞察人心…师父说，这些连仙人都无法做到。我很佩服她。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ab29a13624b49d3821b7be29277b5ba2_1020039119408328943.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗…","content":"与她相处不用讲究礼节，交谈时也不用揣测深意，让我轻松了不少。只是…她身边总是有人，听说船上还有诸多船员…我需要跟你一起，才能应对人多的场合。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4e859e9019c10b2354486393fb1da893_8344730521482583623.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇…","content":"云堇唱的…叫做「璃月戏」吧？我很喜欢这种形式。不必亲见其面，就能了解他人的事迹。如果将来她把你唱进戏里，那一定会是非常精彩的故事，我很期待。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e37eb3a7ab12fbf848ab8d31affb3dbb_4468281760560041797.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于甘雨…","content":"我从师父那里听过许多有关她的事…她原先在我心中的形象，和实际差距还是挺大的。放心，我不会说出去。说起来，璃月港的工作竟这般繁忙…看来融入人间，也要付出一些代价。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1f067923833bb4ce5019a7cf8cfa8a67_1539975847435484298.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云…","content":"真没想到我在这世上…还有「亲缘」。他若是有什么修行上的困惑，我愿帮忙解答。不过，得请他上山来。他们一家太过热情，我不知道该如何回绝才符合礼数…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3b1d9c73dddd7f575deb13e3a12c5555_5862971315974455969.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"我曾见到他凑在你耳旁不知说些什么。若他敢威胁你，我一定会将他…嗯？只是朋友间的玩闹话？当真如此吗…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d3d2f2801f078d89213010db89bc81e1_4172348586822821597.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"那位先生自称是凡人，却与身为仙人的师父很熟络。师父曾说，如果碰见他在仙府前的石凳上饮酒，莫要打扰，让他静静独坐一会。我照做了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7561a4745895a5dd63b8068d8c72b282_3834352903657544691.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于白术…","content":"他的药草品质很好，为人也随和周到。相比起来，脖子上的小蛇倒是口无遮拦…放心，我没有动手。我还不至于和一条蛇置气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9fcaa3c95b021a6e55a47104ad27807c_372941290521144368.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"她在附近山林游荡时，经常会唱奇怪的歌。久而久之，我把她的歌断断续续听了个遍。听习惯了也还是觉得奇怪，但，我并不讨厌。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/edebf9c5da4a0db2b3988d129059b45b_4270286345811192525.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"印象中他一直不苟言笑。近来见他，虽说沉默依旧，但…像是比从前轻松了不少。兴许是结识了哪位良人吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6de2ab4300a47e50166c285a8f520969_2564592708885850062.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于闲云","content":"\t\n上回，师父带漱玉来万民堂吃饭，漱玉言谈间已有了几分师父的神形…我也是在师父的呵护下如此成长，不知道我的举止，是否也带着些师父的样子呢…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/22/271743012/5dace6aff1aacc833d5c2cdbb625487f_4677916362591792115.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"dqahvikrl92rbo6bli9j0drvvdcu46a.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其一","content":"请不必在意人们对我的称呼，我不是仙人，也没什么神通。生于驱魔世家的旁系，长在远离璃月港的山间，只能算是个仙家弟子，仅此而已。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a92cd03f8946fae4daf62546d70c9359_5060456379604359715.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其二","content":"遇到恶意滋事的人，人们似乎都会选择上前说教，我不太明白。明明可以直接将这些拦路碍事、心存歹念的恶人斩草除根，为什么要这般麻烦？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b2e1bfeab68add10bf0639b0b305f084_7277093339016170244.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其三","content":"我师从多位仙家，静心修炼。随着修为提升，他们不再传授我新的术式，而是改教我怎样收敛杀性。别紧张…像平地凿出深坑，树木连根拔起之类的事，只在远离人烟的山林中发生过，从未波及过无辜性命。况且，现在我也已经能控制自我了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d2acf388776f7d9a65736afa1eb8a15b_8870145223938426767.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其四","content":"父亲想用我的血肉换回母亲的生命。自从被他丢在山洞，我一度期盼过他会回来救我。一天、两天、三天…我拼尽全力与魔物厮杀，直到倒下都没能等到他。我不知道，究竟是我命格孤煞才遭人遗弃，还是命途坎坷使得我萌生出这股煞气？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/060f463a8dcda2b4322b9c5b9b11f4a2_7311427739254617693.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其五","content":"有一回，我瞒着师父偷偷下山回到村里，却发现原本的村庄荒弃了，父亲早已去世。我突然明白，自己与血亲的缘分彻底断绝了。在乎的往事永无后话。自那日起，我一度舍弃人间种种…直到遇见你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/914b6f67f715ff597bfa4d4d63b012e0_585033297546070318.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"申鹤的爱好…","content":"打坐的要点在于「静」，需要摒弃杂念，用身体感受周遭气息，它能让我迅速回归自我。听师父说，修为达到足够境界后，打坐的姿势就不用再拘泥，仙人哪怕站立着都能打坐…我还远远不够。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/31db44abeefba9c35320f2eb6bb5650e_967154895275771191.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"申鹤的烦恼…","content":"害怕失去重要之人、想要拯救重要之人…这种心情会将整颗心紧紧揪住，以前从未体会过。这是困扰，但…也是寄托。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/246d9e19f8812e8d0f2b07fe5735cea2_1122625706836762987.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"下山期间尝了不少菜，但都不太记得味道了。唯独从前在家吃的那碗面，永远忘不了…不该记住才对，不该记住才对…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9bd3acabe8500f4c969ad85335c41676_4141754828856652004.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"药草嚼得久了，只剩苦味与涩味…修行多年，我早已习惯这些清规戒律了。仙人们？「仙人不会被人间俗物阻碍修为，所以可以敞开吃各式菜肴。」…这是师父的原话。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8f57221d64cf8de9707f5165eff3e2be_1559383054716473837.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"这般滋味…真的是我能够享受的吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/f49bb76a4a24920aa842309353f93f55_2222522492724933771.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"你做的饭菜，确实美味。无法割舍。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/ed7934e0b9a65712da08420ec951a776_7095153761745883670.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"也好。这样的味道，我早就熟悉了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/1db1bee6abcee2c045755a1fd0efd55c_8960125005434446952.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"我听说生辰是个值得铭记的日子，人们会向寿星送上礼品以示庆贺。身外之物，我不太了解。银河夜色，是我在山林中见过最美丽的事物。我将湖面冻成明镜，让浮云和星斗映照在眼前，跟你共贺生辰…希望你喜欢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/459aa4d231fcdf07875465291ab47c1f_1970198785753959919.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"我能操控的力量…愈发强大了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0616706ad6f8031c2e0634d41861d1b0_6816995993678980380.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"师父若知道了，怕是会让我多系几根红绳吧…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/11337c04e0309db9646d34394e2deb2e_8349882183644977078.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"这段日子，我闭关修炼的时长有所削减，修为却不知不觉地增进…嗯，也许只有跟你一起才能做到。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1a0f9f51bc6fa95dda40393aef80dbc4_1819131668609276251.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"「心无杂念，方可超然」，这是我从前所想。经历种种才明白，唯有心存牵挂，才能唤醒守护的欲望，让力量…变得有意义。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/16d4d4ab467ff5cc30387c7c4eb449fe_5882439542533992256.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"听令！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fcdf8f1390559fc6523b69f4e8908bd7_6654604963437666388.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"显！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/20602f7f9b7a18185a22dac84c5e5f8f_8736220990543222424.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"魂出！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cd663acd32fb088123530ebaee2ff981_2242450367187626409.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"炼气化神！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b05b1dbc0b75f6eb9177b3ef2663e599_5902937671737969902.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"意生冰身！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5e92e029a4db8b3abd5fa331f6b80389_5214508694707043942.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其六","content":"付君真形！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d00955f7af0becc6ad086d2785d930db_1584287946968721933.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"天真敕奏！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5ab58598cea498f460564b81f8be7d76_1050613756083918220.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"寒冰变神！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/063fc01978b6f9889577bd22e8bbde19_618798985805662153.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"依律奉行！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/edbeeaf2de34ac0de4379dbffa9266a5_8949558197591893288.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"这就是凡间的宝物吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4bf719f9eb049bf510b298093f8a5413_8004235383783471244.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"与仙人法宝有何区别？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d3cd0ebd1523a4ff6db324a9bf7633d2_486614925600806258.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"这些东西…该用到何处？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f8bc7fd09d15fdf5c3b86d6f04b0c167_1438091322651435938.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"休要怪我…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/001dd2cd7c541fa2aeb6ed706d8d5d0b_1587003880900766881.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"我不甘心…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e46f26ac1bcdf23df8e515e950c56235_2301328159219949527.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"必须…诛除！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/41bb87878f96fb12df0565d262599cc2_5439834885877637206.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"不必勉强。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/1518812037d2980d28d701d797b80cc1_6681843788575141707.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"我来了结。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/004ed89d49695c3ce328ededdac5de04_6148115855988786749.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"难逃…宿命…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/029866eb0b7ef4924df290628b1d4502_8033829026337091487.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"死丧既定…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/66c9cffb6e5b199f1ee089cb7fdb9a33_9128484530721349747.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"劫煞为灾…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/70364c6022f756e207347aed1cd40f87_6637529119848811072.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"不成气候。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6259199acb4dd24cc1395239f8312fcd_7651895249462502236.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"休想！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cd826be0377984d5807bd13f86dd9e25_1170610346529874269.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"别后悔！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6c3d0871603f21c82ef6aa549977d374_3043021177688646880.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"团队作战…是什么意思？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ac17c20c4934196fac4b0fc35fc90ab4_1250883609043274019.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"明白，站在这里就行了是吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a72d0cee18f72a7c18e755a02925c721_5482667109036983951.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"…听君敕令。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e1e2396dd72db9058b39ddc77720a692_2161653509639813485.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1703116297999_1"},{"tab_name":"韩语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我名申鹤，命格孤煞，易伤身边人，仙人叮嘱要以此红绳锁魂，控制杀心。若你不畏惧与我同行…很好，就请伸出手来吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5515d58e478f31e9aa57aa4d38c0b3b2_1595729475564465488.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·归宿","content":"人间的归宿是一种奢望，我早已习惯跟山川与鸟兽作伴了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/98c10513a56f8acd3c3607ee13f2f1ff_6234368308961821628.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·要诀","content":"回向正道，保身护命…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e13ae5e55d5986aaaa51c94a3220588f_3124397660234157231.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·刀枪无眼","content":"刀枪无眼，红绳的力量也有极限，所以我才不喜欢人多的地方。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7ce244d6d6d02ab6222dc57b07ad583c_7835826530531211629.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"按照凡人的做法，这种时候，是否应该…撑伞？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e83acaae607abbd53393ba1d2a5db302_6222987171070879311.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"雨过天晴…","content":"天气变好，我也很开心。只希望没有人来打扰…如果有，就让他们消失好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bf618016891f184c10af2ef1c839f168_4774745749260638704.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"把魔物冻在原地，雷劈下来就能瞬间解决它们，还不会让衣服沾上尘土。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3fe00abb04d7150360a02c37c33a3677_2208418115073361810.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"嗯…师父最喜欢庆云顶上的罡风。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eb3a86268e7b19092bedcf101b1cdc2b_2187294237147906505.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早安。晨露很甜，要分一点给你吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8929f9c82fb9cd228022fcdbece10efe_6228823043889655876.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"若是午后困乏，不妨试试打坐养神，很有效果。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9a4247c2319f416f13d61e355cbc7cbb_2672138612745859560.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"不知道你是喜欢人间的灯火，还是山林的月光？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/954094c893dca72a2dbd2398aeba9653_1217360657594667374.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"放心休息吧，我睡眠很浅，有什么动静，我会替你查看的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e2ec90adfb37da2caf891dfd002ffbae_5948602594203263376.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤自己·本能","content":"磨砺自身，修炼方术，都是本能使然，想要保全自己而已。我没有兼济苍生的胸怀，惩奸除恶只是顺手，不必感谢我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0d12862a9a4a9433981d346525b4fd66_7618077561095737395.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤自己·异类","content":"受我恩惠的人叫我仙人，被我惩罚的人喊我魔女，呵…不管是仙是魔，终究都是跟凡人不同的异类罢了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d183b7e95fb225e972312c8bb547c3e5_669565721234623639.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·待人接物","content":"我很少下山，不懂得多少待人接物的道理。发生冲突的时候，我一律按自己的方式处理。但，如果你觉得不妥，都请告诉我，即使不理解，我也会听你的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cbccc206b7ac33bc8709ee5ea5a26aae_6821668092968035444.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·红绳","content":"师父赐我红绳用以压制心性，但这些日子你我同修，我才真正领悟到要诀，力量收放也更自在…你才是真正能锁住我的红绳。若你懂得这份心情，就请留在我身旁。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6f62ed09cbbdb805202950c943f9c16f_179672136156263919.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"原来这颗闪耀的石头叫做「神之眼」？呵…有缘既得，无缘便失。日后倘若缘分消散，它也会熄灭吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/561ff114cfa7a47306e9509903ef8c0d_2293389445257190389.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"邪祟易驱，心魔难除。若自身无法放下执念，仙法与术式都无从挽回。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c09ad3edc2e40e9bc7b194dc90c62a11_3310038947677770640.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"为什么说「初雪多浪漫」？那处山巅日日下雪，何日才算是初雪？我不理解，请你告诉我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3f22625dfa3b21bf741aaaac1d26d082_313289207018625620.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"人们所谓的财富，对我而言没什么用。但到了凝光小姐手里，却能解决连刀枪都无法处理的难题。她能掌握人间规则，洞察人心…师父说，这些连仙人都无法做到。我很佩服她。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d58628ef66636f840988363b6fa4691b_6878198183166096203.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗…","content":"与她相处不用讲究礼节，交谈时也不用揣测深意，让我轻松了不少。只是…她身边总是有人，听说船上还有诸多船员…我需要跟你一起，才能应对人多的场合。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e6e628ca64a5db450e0a1b060fa5db25_1598357001355257056.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇…","content":"云堇唱的…叫做「璃月戏」吧？我很喜欢这种形式。不必亲见其面，就能了解他人的事迹。如果将来她把你唱进戏里，那一定会是非常精彩的故事，我很期待。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2793eb36a0b0fcd4848e50258699841a_2109779618735594206.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于甘雨…","content":"我从师父那里听过许多有关她的事…她原先在我心中的形象，和实际差距还是挺大的。放心，我不会说出去。说起来，璃月港的工作竟这般繁忙…看来融入人间，也要付出一些代价。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7641313f6f3b47caab272b2ac9761d03_3981786873574495559.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云…","content":"真没想到我在这世上…还有「亲缘」。他若是有什么修行上的困惑，我愿帮忙解答。不过，得请他上山来。他们一家太过热情，我不知道该如何回绝才符合礼数…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/425a279bfcb5283e2692ab6a6797978c_3498744438155274216.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"我曾见到他凑在你耳旁不知说些什么。若他敢威胁你，我一定会将他…嗯？只是朋友间的玩闹话？当真如此吗…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e4947cff6e1714dcec8e6fea5376031b_4050437077287776646.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"那位先生自称是凡人，却与身为仙人的师父很熟络。师父曾说，如果碰见他在仙府前的石凳上饮酒，莫要打扰，让他静静独坐一会。我照做了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7f4937c6e761724f0b7ff6a1b7edc79e_1306225391298989422.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于白术…","content":"他的药草品质很好，为人也随和周到。相比起来，脖子上的小蛇倒是口无遮拦…放心，我没有动手。我还不至于和一条蛇置气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dbd587ccd05c4cc609741535a182dbaf_9105262247997270640.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"她在附近山林游荡时，经常会唱奇怪的歌。久而久之，我把她的歌断断续续听了个遍。听习惯了也还是觉得奇怪，但，我并不讨厌。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b9197506ee539bfec56c644b678e9163_2176519587012165652.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"印象中他一直不苟言笑。近来见他，虽说沉默依旧，但…像是比从前轻松了不少。兴许是结识了哪位良人吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/229355106f28a9f62a2908a5e5803bb0_225269216920042976.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于闲云","content":"\t\n上回，师父带漱玉来万民堂吃饭，漱玉言谈间已有了几分师父的神形…我也是在师父的呵护下如此成长，不知道我的举止，是否也带着些师父的样子呢…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/22/271743012/649dd4b987b57058ca11cea79f082e94_3519409106508810900.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"22jmysz4bxxn8dmu3lfmcud68dmntgq.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其一","content":"请不必在意人们对我的称呼，我不是仙人，也没什么神通。生于驱魔世家的旁系，长在远离璃月港的山间，只能算是个仙家弟子，仅此而已。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b10eae14e17fc469e447852842754126_3474653866785702878.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其二","content":"遇到恶意滋事的人，人们似乎都会选择上前说教，我不太明白。明明可以直接将这些拦路碍事、心存歹念的恶人斩草除根，为什么要这般麻烦？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/68099310a4611761e652a402c7b64992_5961003961756192227.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其三","content":"我师从多位仙家，静心修炼。随着修为提升，他们不再传授我新的术式，而是改教我怎样收敛杀性。别紧张…像平地凿出深坑，树木连根拔起之类的事，只在远离人烟的山林中发生过，从未波及过无辜性命。况且，现在我也已经能控制自我了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cd797cf7f423bbb095919fd57fd4e10b_1251678906080593452.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其四","content":"父亲想用我的血肉换回母亲的生命。自从被他丢在山洞，我一度期盼过他会回来救我。一天、两天、三天…我拼尽全力与魔物厮杀，直到倒下都没能等到他。我不知道，究竟是我命格孤煞才遭人遗弃，还是命途坎坷使得我萌生出这股煞气？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cf799893e7d49559cd52f3f544202b3b_6976843661520132633.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其五","content":"有一回，我瞒着师父偷偷下山回到村里，却发现原本的村庄荒弃了，父亲早已去世。我突然明白，自己与血亲的缘分彻底断绝了。在乎的往事永无后话。自那日起，我一度舍弃人间种种…直到遇见你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cf2c91704125a91aa8a572a8cc8e03ef_7286851764848761365.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"申鹤的爱好…","content":"打坐的要点在于「静」，需要摒弃杂念，用身体感受周遭气息，它能让我迅速回归自我。听师父说，修为达到足够境界后，打坐的姿势就不用再拘泥，仙人哪怕站立着都能打坐…我还远远不够。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/be4257bf0dae5979274e9ba1e2ba8ab6_7624199724650736794.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"申鹤的烦恼…","content":"害怕失去重要之人、想要拯救重要之人…这种心情会将整颗心紧紧揪住，以前从未体会过。这是困扰，但…也是寄托。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fb1e58915a1fd128b19435c77af753f4_6103651448069075518.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"下山期间尝了不少菜，但都不太记得味道了。唯独从前在家吃的那碗面，永远忘不了…不该记住才对，不该记住才对…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/953588cef78ee1b43c965cb1cd9b3d11_195872658009757414.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"药草嚼得久了，只剩苦味与涩味…修行多年，我早已习惯这些清规戒律了。仙人们？「仙人不会被人间俗物阻碍修为，所以可以敞开吃各式菜肴。」…这是师父的原话。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8323b209c2876ea578b01f6f0b0d37f0_8500146645233971456.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"这般滋味…真的是我能够享受的吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/ec1d10104635b1047dc6fdf547316c56_3787503856216918418.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"你做的饭菜，确实美味。无法割舍。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/d1cacdc8b792ab6e9ec3667f66fe2c10_6995295975374500844.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"也好。这样的味道，我早就熟悉了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/393ea591d5c056c58f0c8d8e24d25c0e_4813331885661145643.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"我听说生辰是个值得铭记的日子，人们会向寿星送上礼品以示庆贺。身外之物，我不太了解。银河夜色，是我在山林中见过最美丽的事物。我将湖面冻成明镜，让浮云和星斗映照在眼前，跟你共贺生辰…希望你喜欢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/87cf3a29bd219b8052e61cee35b9e4f2_3240214913261964049.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"我能操控的力量…愈发强大了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d33db7646a35a62f779a310dbcca1b5b_8784952861057633347.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"师父若知道了，怕是会让我多系几根红绳吧…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dc18784e54d21373dfcee0af3a4e46c0_4019317668263662394.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"这段日子，我闭关修炼的时长有所削减，修为却不知不觉地增进…嗯，也许只有跟你一起才能做到。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8b1aa7830b8fe513657d0ad346a1dbb8_8945873144670858171.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"「心无杂念，方可超然」，这是我从前所想。经历种种才明白，唯有心存牵挂，才能唤醒守护的欲望，让力量…变得有意义。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d8d1005d39357c217e3848c38c9b4a7f_1218468197331686144.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"听令！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bbee337eaa815327f9157f7f8d31b7ca_5523220658787622564.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"显！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/90e5487bc3e6f8fe02c3763a86a16395_3700052084785340154.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"魂出！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6adcb90fb815e0eca9df754ea1f7f4ad_545376842049765370.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"炼气化神！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e575b28f2ea0b58d704a61d56cca9298_6219227652891982299.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"意生冰身！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/05babd8f1657fa0a6f4a371bfdefc463_8430918498579978433.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其六","content":"付君真形！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d198accfab1a5f5e34bdb9c46813d078_5908431422227687709.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"天真敕奏！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d34c02a20bbbd7f5a0b0acd224fd25a3_2787435140635673802.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"寒冰变神！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/075dc2c5cfd75a805a341f37bb1d60be_1710003649515572142.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"依律奉行！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/942422565bba4531e827f452d5eb5467_3044722362832543518.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"这就是凡间的宝物吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c47a1d51eba6f5a4666d6f0583d5671a_3919719965923056906.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"与仙人法宝有何区别？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fd2014c1db85ee4f503767ca3f605f57_5012413212508613339.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"这些东西…该用到何处？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d24d52b06accde8ac94c076bc5659a7d_6814025915305881532.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"休要怪我…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2dc676abb71e032d49c2741da65d25fb_5627823783349375531.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"我不甘心…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b6c445aa2fc6989560dc02ee604d8628_3039273775505097106.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"必须…诛除！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a50e8a287fe11ab28e1139ad9a69e513_1319133435909146111.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"不必勉强。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/5b607d9aedf0312c0131ff30b7895a99_2942168167012172438.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"我来了结。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/e324b9b5f0d6d983823f8d40ab7968b4_5143881310529185861.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"难逃…宿命…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/461f66a8795d412b21f6a8ac8b6ecc89_8407442873749969455.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"死丧既定…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d5ced458a71a36d611ea046823e12248_6116667786211455037.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"劫煞为灾…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/409b42109a820688c6fcb0551d05450d_6816428360824619683.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"不成气候。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/27031c4a8c3eaa51d77c6ca065350c18_8434304385551958742.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"休想！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cd91ef0c809536da92c180e926bc33bf_7796087490546610312.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"别后悔！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/359838ace363634614e238aec5e7e4ef_8679740820982610729.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"团队作战…是什么意思？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f6440ba7fd5714aead55a03431d71289_7239467542257024521.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"明白，站在这里就行了是吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8b30ffbf4f01c30449bb74b239180962_4493517176124726614.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"…听君敕令。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f877f04b2da3ad865c3387174b9872d5_8560651027284985767.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1703116297999_2"},{"tab_name":"英语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我名申鹤，命格孤煞，易伤身边人，仙人叮嘱要以此红绳锁魂，控制杀心。若你不畏惧与我同行…很好，就请伸出手来吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ae5c319379a3a5ebad696361428615c3_5372253963260739970.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·归宿","content":"人间的归宿是一种奢望，我早已习惯跟山川与鸟兽作伴了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/499ea3fdb76a108524bf3ac8d47e8ca6_942585655582475051.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·要诀","content":"回向正道，保身护命…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7240028dcdd17e8118cf133572a9413d_439419895889829286.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·刀枪无眼","content":"刀枪无眼，红绳的力量也有极限，所以我才不喜欢人多的地方。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a77ca1e9656039f2248870090d36e203_3800607743445924238.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"按照凡人的做法，这种时候，是否应该…撑伞？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9c42fb6d2512fa6eadc7061d7b146f70_1895259243006517862.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"雨过天晴…","content":"天气变好，我也很开心。只希望没有人来打扰…如果有，就让他们消失好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1ca0748f42785de913a19ebd7910746d_4398200304104108612.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"把魔物冻在原地，雷劈下来就能瞬间解决它们，还不会让衣服沾上尘土。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1c509a2db9d6aa7312643a212205cf2a_4833906876994539265.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"嗯…师父最喜欢庆云顶上的罡风。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3cb2f160961f5f69e7cb98bf64bc87fb_8184033947175304297.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早安。晨露很甜，要分一点给你吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/70af1a4d1be526d5899e3707eb7c9c0d_5334265161851014203.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"若是午后困乏，不妨试试打坐养神，很有效果。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/63c879e5d90d9d66798cea2a77270eec_9113127119457825189.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"不知道你是喜欢人间的灯火，还是山林的月光？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a7e56dea93522f7f2e22d742e2eca2dd_6207923555472827275.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"放心休息吧，我睡眠很浅，有什么动静，我会替你查看的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b5fcc4e9d94f60e1e897fd1f3a3e9367_6132734811738863803.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤自己·本能","content":"磨砺自身，修炼方术，都是本能使然，想要保全自己而已。我没有兼济苍生的胸怀，惩奸除恶只是顺手，不必感谢我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/853d59726a7973c61af8fbb033e08c92_5761504802862637050.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤自己·异类","content":"受我恩惠的人叫我仙人，被我惩罚的人喊我魔女，呵…不管是仙是魔，终究都是跟凡人不同的异类罢了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/15741324ede24c3363c7af4b51e503de_7621038115367296499.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·待人接物","content":"我很少下山，不懂得多少待人接物的道理。发生冲突的时候，我一律按自己的方式处理。但，如果你觉得不妥，都请告诉我，即使不理解，我也会听你的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fc7a25da8a9faa358a8c2ec2dc9d8a8a_2500590672547408262.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·红绳","content":"师父赐我红绳用以压制心性，但这些日子你我同修，我才真正领悟到要诀，力量收放也更自在…你才是真正能锁住我的红绳。若你懂得这份心情，就请留在我身旁。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a408e2939d3e478b1ddc09b0a1026258_1288695418327466917.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"原来这颗闪耀的石头叫做「神之眼」？呵…有缘既得，无缘便失。日后倘若缘分消散，它也会熄灭吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c8fdd3257fd74fb637596e82f4d049f5_2708546436649546907.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"邪祟易驱，心魔难除。若自身无法放下执念，仙法与术式都无从挽回。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/30a33afc99d94beac937a350d0b894f3_4004581424381627013.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"为什么说「初雪多浪漫」？那处山巅日日下雪，何日才算是初雪？我不理解，请你告诉我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/89bd58cd2fd8f8ceeba25de2e65a568e_3151422051955154917.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"人们所谓的财富，对我而言没什么用。但到了凝光小姐手里，却能解决连刀枪都无法处理的难题。她能掌握人间规则，洞察人心…师父说，这些连仙人都无法做到。我很佩服她。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/32f76a50294db4b85fea33d91397db04_8421198630652174983.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗…","content":"与她相处不用讲究礼节，交谈时也不用揣测深意，让我轻松了不少。只是…她身边总是有人，听说船上还有诸多船员…我需要跟你一起，才能应对人多的场合。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/97e25b0886f88642512d2ea928ed169c_2469981559795499243.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇…","content":"云堇唱的…叫做「璃月戏」吧？我很喜欢这种形式。不必亲见其面，就能了解他人的事迹。如果将来她把你唱进戏里，那一定会是非常精彩的故事，我很期待。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fb1bee5a098c75e15980e5b34c360f01_3425421085077615278.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于甘雨…","content":"我从师父那里听过许多有关她的事…她原先在我心中的形象，和实际差距还是挺大的。放心，我不会说出去。说起来，璃月港的工作竟这般繁忙…看来融入人间，也要付出一些代价。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5fdd9233fe31937cf2a1297f80917fd3_3732942392105481853.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云…","content":"真没想到我在这世上…还有「亲缘」。他若是有什么修行上的困惑，我愿帮忙解答。不过，得请他上山来。他们一家太过热情，我不知道该如何回绝才符合礼数…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4e13550330c7f335b10c56f7ffca5c86_4981480873114973000.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"我曾见到他凑在你耳旁不知说些什么。若他敢威胁你，我一定会将他…嗯？只是朋友间的玩闹话？当真如此吗…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/02c4fd5d91e200a4085651677d9299d2_5184285354217608388.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"那位先生自称是凡人，却与身为仙人的师父很熟络。师父曾说，如果碰见他在仙府前的石凳上饮酒，莫要打扰，让他静静独坐一会。我照做了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8e7e9a4fb50efd808f24bd271a56909b_9034195253085658371.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于白术…","content":"他的药草品质很好，为人也随和周到。相比起来，脖子上的小蛇倒是口无遮拦…放心，我没有动手。我还不至于和一条蛇置气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/00d4bde8b7205f3e63e38a7ad777c97a_6224744549968748320.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"她在附近山林游荡时，经常会唱奇怪的歌。久而久之，我把她的歌断断续续听了个遍。听习惯了也还是觉得奇怪，但，我并不讨厌。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a2b50cb25c5574ca38fa83b53cfd7597_8071639908545713013.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"印象中他一直不苟言笑。近来见他，虽说沉默依旧，但…像是比从前轻松了不少。兴许是结识了哪位良人吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ce14644c98a35b87320a49a909bf6fec_740404955648104631.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于闲云","content":"\t\n上回，师父带漱玉来万民堂吃饭，漱玉言谈间已有了几分师父的神形…我也是在师父的呵护下如此成长，不知道我的举止，是否也带着些师父的样子呢…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/08/22/271743012/c96c6a81267ad7b8aa0ce1027014e01b_2176502309363700309.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"as3pjse9jfftz4hvk8dzjaybix8rem6.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其一","content":"请不必在意人们对我的称呼，我不是仙人，也没什么神通。生于驱魔世家的旁系，长在远离璃月港的山间，只能算是个仙家弟子，仅此而已。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/967fcbcdc87ce91f46526af3500e2838_5579856762347031746.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其二","content":"遇到恶意滋事的人，人们似乎都会选择上前说教，我不太明白。明明可以直接将这些拦路碍事、心存歹念的恶人斩草除根，为什么要这般麻烦？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6131726ac9eb791a05ce59462c158843_7873399935641094934.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其三","content":"我师从多位仙家，静心修炼。随着修为提升，他们不再传授我新的术式，而是改教我怎样收敛杀性。别紧张…像平地凿出深坑，树木连根拔起之类的事，只在远离人烟的山林中发生过，从未波及过无辜性命。况且，现在我也已经能控制自我了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c4e6578d42dba183b2f938c8ad73d8b4_8046577155098731005.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其四","content":"父亲想用我的血肉换回母亲的生命。自从被他丢在山洞，我一度期盼过他会回来救我。一天、两天、三天…我拼尽全力与魔物厮杀，直到倒下都没能等到他。我不知道，究竟是我命格孤煞才遭人遗弃，还是命途坎坷使得我萌生出这股煞气？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7fbf699887d52c40746dbd5ec808b993_2103071008012515103.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解申鹤·其五","content":"有一回，我瞒着师父偷偷下山回到村里，却发现原本的村庄荒弃了，父亲早已去世。我突然明白，自己与血亲的缘分彻底断绝了。在乎的往事永无后话。自那日起，我一度舍弃人间种种…直到遇见你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/02c6b39ded35364416c124b1f0411740_6282457420938466507.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"申鹤的爱好…","content":"打坐的要点在于「静」，需要摒弃杂念，用身体感受周遭气息，它能让我迅速回归自我。听师父说，修为达到足够境界后，打坐的姿势就不用再拘泥，仙人哪怕站立着都能打坐…我还远远不够。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ed8ed837d4c40f1600712cd5f41f90fe_1322586329039752977.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"申鹤的烦恼…","content":"害怕失去重要之人、想要拯救重要之人…这种心情会将整颗心紧紧揪住，以前从未体会过。这是困扰，但…也是寄托。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6d99f9680b04f9357572573a0012fb6a_469992238678672733.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"下山期间尝了不少菜，但都不太记得味道了。唯独从前在家吃的那碗面，永远忘不了…不该记住才对，不该记住才对…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/632a7f4f290d15fea3f69249982ad5b9_4944418126361052004.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"药草嚼得久了，只剩苦味与涩味…修行多年，我早已习惯这些清规戒律了。仙人们？「仙人不会被人间俗物阻碍修为，所以可以敞开吃各式菜肴。」…这是师父的原话。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bf8fa3362c6323414657d827bf854fa2_8437311384254177171.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"这般滋味…真的是我能够享受的吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/ee326fb3faa5d87f182aca233c7f4ef6_8406980872985809597.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"你做的饭菜，确实美味。无法割舍。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/b6863d1faaa0653f25254f2e8f6b3c66_7786353232826795920.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"也好。这样的味道，我早就熟悉了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/e171297ebda1cc70a741de66f9be974e_6038149420888887716.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"我听说生辰是个值得铭记的日子，人们会向寿星送上礼品以示庆贺。身外之物，我不太了解。银河夜色，是我在山林中见过最美丽的事物。我将湖面冻成明镜，让浮云和星斗映照在眼前，跟你共贺生辰…希望你喜欢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/76b96d4d9d4b73c8b9d282252b70c8cb_2159864132127994730.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"我能操控的力量…愈发强大了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e64f1c79e34385eecc6eb4ca6c2bffe7_3502336198908492185.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"师父若知道了，怕是会让我多系几根红绳吧…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0be1cd3ea17d657c2d1be1400f981927_9100952864235999527.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"这段日子，我闭关修炼的时长有所削减，修为却不知不觉地增进…嗯，也许只有跟你一起才能做到。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/aef27c3d8a4b2f68a49e5fb804b03a86_4482114222590562215.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"「心无杂念，方可超然」，这是我从前所想。经历种种才明白，唯有心存牵挂，才能唤醒守护的欲望，让力量…变得有意义。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ca442461e6cece90166a61e38b17a5be_8785861790995999104.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"听令！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/44188ea9f65691592c46e3e1d3e3a385_4922085714217696932.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"显！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/897b5a6f000fce2488ab7cacfba2993c_512015124340971529.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"魂出！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c0bb1d5e3ffb7b513d33a58df0546da1_5519320016221347136.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"炼气化神！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b14ebf70b7fe2ec407e9d69cb5b0edb6_6439186840831930205.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"意生冰身！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ef2e6fd3 璃月的访仙者小群体中，偶尔会传出一两段与仙人相逢的小道流言。

通常是谁谁谁在哪哪哪陷入绝境，千钧一发之时——

一位飘渺绝尘的白发仙子赶到，救人于水火…

之后种种故事，大多与街头文学中被传唱了百八十遍的姻缘佳话无甚区别，大都是些痴绝美绝，引人沉醉的俗套桥段。

可若是让那位白发仙子亲自讲述，却又是截然不同的模样了：

「山中时不时窜出些恼人之物，贼眉鼠眼，看着烦人。索性以术法驱逐出去，免得扰了师父清净。

万一下手不慎，伤了他们头脸手脚…本是自找，也没什么好办法。」

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

在所有看似世外散仙的人物中，申鹤是最不食人间烟火的那个。

年纪轻轻又一直隐居山中的她缺乏经验常识，难以维持正常的人际往来。

对普通人来说，一件事通常有多种解法。但在申鹤眼中，似乎只能看见最简单直接的那一种。

譬如与人意见相左时，她几乎想不到「协商」二字，反而对「威胁」一事驾轻就熟。简单又好使，实在是好办法。

她也曾花上许多时间来思考一些过于脱俗的问题——

吃饭需付钱这件事，究竟是为什么？

恐吓民众和恐吓匪徒有什么区别？

她甚至还发自内心相信，自己的师父留云借风真君是位精于言辞，十分擅长话术的仙人。

所以从这个角度来看，她很纯粹。

如孩童一般，仅靠混沌又朴素的感知与逻辑行走在世上。

理水叠山真君曾说：

「申鹤小女不仅根骨过人，性子也是别具一格。」

「不谙世事，不明常理，不辨菽粟，不知高低。」

「留云借风领她入门，未必是一桩轻松差事。」

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

璃月民间逸话里不乏仙缘故事，多是讲些无名之辈被仙人相中，收入门下，一飞冲天的传奇。

但申鹤拜入仙门的缘由绝非如此。相较起来，甚至是有些苦涩的。

申鹤五岁时，母亲因病去世，父亲爱妻情切，难以承受此中苦痛。

长此以往，竟因念生怨恨，因怨生心魔，发疯似地出门云游。

他—去便是一年，日不停步，夜不能寐，只为寻找复活亡妻的术法。

终于在申鹤年近垂髫之时，父亲狂喜着回来了。

—同带回来的，还有一种名为「凭命借命」的神秘术法——

将祭品献给秘术召唤来的「仙灵」，便能以活人之身，索回亡人之命。

那时，申鹤对将要发生的灾难毫无感知。她不过是个普通孩子，欣喜于久不归家的父亲终于回来。

父亲说在后山的山洞里给她准备了一个大惊喜，马上就带她去看，一切都让她十分开心…

之后那—幕幕，却令申鹤至今难忘——

狰狞可怖的黑色「仙灵」被父亲召唤到山洞内，它血红的眼睛里只有申鹤鲜活的生命。

申鹤惊愕万状，不明白它从何而来，又想从这个家中拿走什么。

危难让人变得迟钝，年幼的申鹤渐渐也只能想着—件事。

怪物想吞了她，可她不想死，她要活下去。

她握住母亲的遗物，一柄驱邪匕首，颤抖又坚定地迎向了黑色「仙灵」…

数日后，仙人循着残留的邪祟气息找来，进洞一探，才发现洞内躺着一个费尽力气，粒米未进，早已奄奄一息的小女孩。

仙人怜惜她命运多舛，也看出她凭一己之力击退了某种可怕的存在，念其天赋，便将她带回府中安养调息，抚顶授道。

如此，才有了如今的申鹤。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

久居山中修习十数年，再如何淡漠的心也会起波澜。

申鹤亦是如此，她在某个心血来潮的夜晚暗自下山，回到曾经的故乡。

她不明白自己是否仍抱有对家与亲缘的眷念，仅仅是遵从着某种朦胧的情思，想要去曾居住过的房屋，看看从前那个执迷不悟的父亲如今过着怎样的生活。

然而，当她回到故地，才从邻人口中得知，父亲早在数年前去世。

儿时生活的旧屋也被典当拆除，所有记忆中的痕迹都已消失在飘摇风雨中。

申鹤丝毫不在乎旁人对她的关注，不愿回应邻里对她的种种疑问。

只是沉默地站在原地，聆听内心深处—瞬而过的呼啸声。

怨恨？执妄？释然？

一瞬之间，什么都有，又什么都没能留存下来，心中仅余—口无波的古井。

甚至是—口彻底干涸的井，失去了可供涟漪存在的水面。

她长久地站在那里，最终迎着人们诧异的目光离开。

每步都走得很慢，一次也没有回头。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

与占星类似，璃月也有以卜卦感知命运的方法。

其中，有两种「命格」令人们避之不及。

—是孤辰之命，命定亲朋离散，孤察—生。

二是劫煞之命，命定多灾多劫，命途凶险。

仙家收留申鹤后，曾由削月筑阳真君出面为幼小的她卜卦。

卦象显示，申鹤的命格既犯孤辰，又冲劫煞，杀性极重，是千年难遇、伤人伤己的大凶命格。

为使申鹤安全长大又不殃及无辜之人，仙人们在申鹤身上施了红绳缚魂之法。

缚住她身上凶煞与杀气的同时，似乎也禁锢了许多本属于人的情绪。

自那以后，琐事越来越难在她心中激起波澜，常人重视的事物之于她也不过是过眼尘埃。

人性越来越弱的她，活像—尊缺乏七情六欲的美丽雕塑。

但令人意外的是，在与那位异乡旅者的接触中，她居然隐约感觉到——

久违的陌生情感逐渐涌现，像是命运深处的东西开始松动了。

或许如削月筑阳真君所说，命由天定，运由人写。申鹤与这人世的故事，还没有走到末尾…

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

申鹤原先也是有着一头青丝的。

起初被带来琥牢山，她整日不发一言，唯一愿做的事就是攀上山岩，望着云海出神。

好在困了也会和衣而眠，渴了也会抔饮山露，饿了还会采几朵清心嚼食。

留云借风真君心如明镜，却未打扰她，而是用仙石制成—把翠钿白玉梳送给申鹤。

留云告诉申鹤，今后若想斩却凡缘，踏入仙门，就用这柄玉梳梳三下头发，算作拜师礼。

申鹤毫不犹豫地照办了。说来也怪，玉梳梳过第一遍，她满头黑发竟自上至下结出一层银霜来。

玉梳再梳第二遍，青丝素练各半。

玉梳梳完第三遍，已是白雪满头。

……

如今，申鹤依旧随身携带这把梳子，作为自身仙缘的见证。

长久的修行中，她早已领悟当初那三梳之礼的含义，正是：

—梳愁云去尾，二梳无喜无悲，三梳白头不悔。

鲜少有人知道，当年在山洞中，被父亲当成祭品的年幼少女如何能凭一己之力与魔物对抗数天数夜。

申鹤虽然生在驱邪世家，却没能从失心疯魔的父亲那里学到半点除魔咒法。

与每一个天真的同龄人一样，她也从未独自面对过生活的凶险。

但在昏黑的山洞里，在那个失去了父母庇护、遭到血亲背叛的绝境里，申鹤蜕变了。

如削月筑阳真君的卦象所示，沉眠在申鹤命中的凶煞、血性与不屈，都在那—刻齐齐爆发出来。

那些力量犹如目不能视的盾，无法看清的剑，武装起了女孩娇弱的身躯。

它们赐给她力量，为她安上獠牙，准许她向面前的低贱魔物发起攻击，誓要将它撕碎，来证明她才是黑暗中最暴戾的邪恶。

接连数日，搏命的战斗—直没有休止。猎人与猎物不停调换身份，势均力敌的局面久未破除…

生死攸关的时刻，神明将目光投向了不凡的女孩。

一颗晶亮的事物落到申鹤的手中。天平完全倒向申鹤，胜负终定。

剔透莹亮的冰之光芒刺破黑暗，如同霞光，预示着未来的路。

从前，它指引申鹤走出苦难的命运，未来，它也将指引申鹤重返尘世。

关于申鹤…

重云

我曾听家中长辈聊起过她。她家的遭遇…很让人同情。原以为这次能够让分家的远亲重回家中，长辈们听说她还活着也都高兴坏了，说是要备上礼物，择个吉日好好聚聚。却没想到，平日根本见不到她的人影…等等，按辈分来算的话，我、我该不会…要叫她「小姨」吧…

行秋

总觉得申鹤小姐看我的眼神里略显凶恶，让我不敢随便跟她搭话。奇怪，难道我无意中得罪过她吗？或者…得罪过她身边的人？

凝光

申鹤小姐近来可好？有劳你多多关照她了。你们帮忙重建群玉阁的事，我一直记在心里，也很是感激。啊，客套话就不多说了，我备了好茶，闲时多来坐坐吧。

甘雨

我和她并不能算是熟悉。只是听留云真君提过几句，听说她性子较凶，要是压抑不住心性，容易对周围造成严重破坏。嗯…会不会是因为平日里太闲了呢？我…我该给她推荐些工作吗？

魈

申鹤似乎对你颇为信赖。…也是。毕竟，世间难得几人能有你这般的善心与热忱。

胡桃

她可真是个有意思的人呐，跟别人都不一样。你说，要是我从现在开始天天吃仙草、喝山露，会不会也变成她那么不染红尘的样子？嘿嘿…

云堇

《神女劈观》的剧本我早就念得烂熟，但直到今天我才知道「神女」原来真有其人，世上缘分果然奇妙。惟愿她往后都有好友相伴，不再孤寂。

瑶瑶

申鹤姐姐远离世俗多年，这次好不容易回到了璃月港，难免有很多不适应的地方。我也想帮着甘雨姐姐一起照顾她…可我要怎么开口，才不会让她觉得不自在呢？

闲云

申鹤说她有一次给万民堂送外卖，为了节省时间，直接踩着屋顶过去，从屋顶跳到人家门口，把顾客吓了一跳，差点要喊千岩军…好在她来去如风，没等顾客喊出口，早已放下外卖消失不见了。申鹤这孩子处理危机的能力真是越来越强，本仙很是欣慰。

主题：新菜…

发件人：申鹤

时间：2026-03-10

不知道为何，最近来店里吃「水煮黑背鲈」的客人格外多。上菜的时候，我看见一名枫丹人把鱼肉先放在白水里涮了一圈，然后才放进嘴里。

香菱时不时就瞟一眼那个客人，手里的锅勺也甩得比平时更用力，最后终于忍不住走上前，问那个客人是不是吃不了辣…

之后，香菱重新做了一道减辣的「水煮黑背鲈」送给了客人，客人吃得眉开眼笑，差点连盘子里的汁水都喝光了。

……

店里闲下来的时候，香菱问我想要什么生日礼物，我说，想请她教我做减辣版的「水煮黑背鲈」。

这样，下次你来店里时，无论你喜欢辣还是不辣，我都能做给你吃。

主题：你的烦恼…

发件人：申鹤

时间：2025-03-10

不久前，有两位客人在万民堂用餐，那位小姐在离开时对同行的先生哭诉：「只分甘不共苦的感情就像须弥的流沙」…

起初，我并未洞见其中深意，直至观察身边同伴后才逐渐发觉，亲密的家人间，似乎不只有欢乐的话题。平时，香菱会对卯先生抱怨烹饪难题，而师父也总会叮嘱我，出门在外，如遇烦恼，要及时对她说。

我希望，你我也能达到如此地步。因此，请说出你的烦恼，我会认真聆听，如有需要，我会全力出手。

至于我的困扰…嗯，不如相见后我再一一坦白吧。

主题：我的手艺…

发件人：申鹤

时间：2024-03-10

最近这段时日，但凡得闲，我便在一旁观察和学习卯先生的烹饪技法，摘录笔记，由此总结了不少经验。

但当我自己动起手来，却遭遇了重重阻得。比如说拆解鸭骨一不小心就会用力过猛，将鸭肉撕散；制作茶酥时又因为将面皮擀得过薄，最后在包馅时露出里面的馅料…我不想放弃，所以在那之后，我又练习了许多次，香菱和锅巴也给了我不少鼓励。

现在，请你尝尝我的手艺。

主题：生辰…

发件人：申鹤

时间：2023-03-10

今日一早，师父特意为我熬了药膳汤，又做了好几道精致的菜肴，还请来了削月筑阳和理水叠山两位真君小聚一番。

洞府之内，温和的饭菜香气配合熟悉的交谈氛围，令人安心。

我也收集了琉璃袋内凝结的露水，取出了存放许久的甘香药草，制成了简单的茶点。虽不能与师父的厨艺相提并论，但它也代表了我的些许心意…和踏入人世的改变。

若是你愿在品尝后略作评点，我心中就没有缺憾了。

另外，药膳汤的分量很足。我只盛了一小碗，又将余下的药汤当成汤底，为你做了一碗面…希望你喜欢。

主题：长久…

发件人：申鹤

时间：2022-03-10

在你那边，过生日的这一天，需要遵循什么习俗吗？

以往师父知我不需身外之物，每到此日，只会送上一句祝福。

因此，生日要吃「长寿面」这种说法，我也是最近才学来的。

我无意追求寿命的长度，却想与结缘之人相处得长久。

我向擅长烹饪的师父请教，要怎样才能将它做得足够好吃，师父却希望我自己领悟。

我不知道自己究竟悟出了几分，或许这只能由你来评判。

我等你来。
